name: Bricks Family Restaurant
notes: not_found. This is the all-you-can-eat hot breakfast/dinner buffet at the LEGOLAND Hotel (identical offering to the Castle Hotel's Dragon's Den). The official legoland.com dining page describes it (full hot breakfast buffet, all-you-can-eat) but publishes no price at all, per-item or per-person, on the page - checked the full text and the only literal '$' characters on the page are SVG path data and JS, not prices. A buffet with no published per-item pricing is a legitimate not-found by design, same as other buffet restaurants in this corpus.

notes: Work list has no website; found harumamasd.com (own site) with three linked PDF menus. The main food PDF has an extractable text layer but pdftotext -layout scrambles its multi-column poster layout past reliable parsing, and the drink and lunch-combo PDFs set their prices in a font whose numerals do not extract as text at all (dollar signs present, digits blank) - both were abandoned. Instead used the restaurant's own Toast ordering storefront (linked from harumamasd.com/order-online), pulled from window.__OO_STATE__. A 'Sauces' section of $1-2 condiment add-ons (soy, spicy mayo, etc.) was excluded as modifiers rather than dishes. Categories reached: N/A Beverages, Ramen & Mama's, Mama's Bites, Skillets, Poke, Rolls, Buns, Sweets. The drink/sake/beer list and the lunch-combo pricing were not recoverable and are not included.
